metadata.title: Erdős Problem #982, n = 12: DRUP proofs for the certified SAT search
metadata.description: DRUP proofs (gzipped) for the certified computer search showing that no strictly convex 12-gon has at most 5 distinct distances from every vertex (Erdős Problem #982). One proof per 50-piece batch of each cover (exactly-5, below-5, unified at-most-5), plus per-piece proofs for re-certified batches. Every proof was checked by drat-trim and, via LRAT, by the formally verified checker cake_lpr. Code, manifests (with the SHA-256 of every proof) and the algebraic certificate are in the GitHub repository https://github.com/Paulee314/erdos982. The proofs can also be regenerated deterministically with that code. Reassemble each archive with: cat NAME.tar.part* | tar xf -
